A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-walkerbarrage-PC-Errata-2018-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Walker Barrage (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the 2017 slip. This is a full card image again, 350 × 490 pixels, with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
